lines.zh: 铁蹄压在碎石上，声音很闷。
lines.en: Iron hooves press the rubble with a dull sound.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草都黄了。
lines.en: The grass turns yellow where I walk.

lines.zh: 背上那层锈，磨得我脖子疼。
lines.en: The rust on my back chafes my neck.
One heavy step at a time; I am in no hurry.

lines.zh: 象牙蹭过石壁，留下白痕。
lines.en: My tusks scrape the wall and leave white marks.
The ground here is soft; my feet never settle.

lines.zh: 毒从蹄缝里渗出来，滴成坑。
lines.en: Venom seeps from my hoof seams and pits the ground.
I walk toward whatever smells alive.

lines.zh: 这片雾太重，我只看见脚。
lines.en: This fog is thick; I only see my feet.
My body is too heavy; speed makes me wheeze.
I pass a skeleton and don't slow down.
My iron hide hits a tree; the tree breaks first.
I stand still while venom drips off my jaw.
Wind stirs and rust flakes fall around me.
I grind my teeth; it sounds like filing iron.
The shell is too thick to scratch an itch.
I smell the acid on my own hide.

lines.zh: 远处有响动，我抬起鼻子。
lines.en: Something moves far off; I lift my snout.

lines.zh: 重量压着四条腿，懒得动。
lines.en: My weight presses four legs; I'd rather not move.

lines.zh: 毒在体内转，我得停一停。
lines.en: The venom cycles inside; I need to pause.
I growl once and dust lifts off the ground.

lines.zh: 这地方太空，连虫都没有。
lines.en: This place is so empty there aren't even insects.
You stand there, so I watch you.
Your blood jumps beneath your skin.

lines.zh: 你比石头软，我看得出来。
lines.en: You are softer than stone; I can tell.

lines.zh: 我歪头，找你的护甲接缝。
lines.en: I tilt my head to find a seam in your armor.
Half a pace back; I have your measure now.
Your eyes slid away from mine.

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上新鲜的铁。
lines.en: I smell fresh iron on you.

lines.zh: 别动，我在数你露皮的地方。
lines.en: Hold still; I'm counting your exposed patches.
You raised a hand like you mean to run.
I keep that face as a marker.
The blade catches in my rust.
It hurts, and the venom runs faster.
Under the cracked shell is black flesh.

lines.zh: 这一下砍穿了两层铁皮。
lines.en: That cut went through two layers of iron.

lines.zh: 我退一步，坑里的泥在晃。
lines.en: I step back and the mud in my pit sloshes.
Your blade is starting to blacken.
I bleed, and my blood is acid.
Keep this up and you will tire first.

lines.zh: 断了一根象牙，还剩一根。
lines.en: One tusk broke; I still have the other.
Don't touch my wound.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，闻着能吃。
lines.en: That thing in your hand smells edible.
Anything that moves counts as a meal.
That smell is sweet; a fruit?
Hold it higher; I can't smell it clearly.

lines.zh: 我舌头是黑的，尝不出好坏。
lines.en: My tongue is black; I can't taste good from bad.

lines.zh: 你伸出手，我往前挪一步。
lines.en: You held out your hand and I shifted forward.
One touch of my fang ends it; sure?
This weighs less than one of my teeth.
Smells like something alive; don't fool me.
Come closer and I'll take it as feeding time.
One bump and your shoulder will bruise.

lines.zh: 我的皮有锈，你的手会疼。
lines.en: My hide is rusted; your hand will sting.
Stand firm; I don't step aside.
You've got venom on you; don't rub it.

lines.zh: 这么近，象牙够到你胸口。
lines.en: This close, my tusk reaches your chest.
As you back off, your feet slip.

lines.zh: 挤压声从你甲里传出来。
lines.en: A creak comes out of your armor.
Iron on iron, and the sound grates.
I give you half a step; generous of me.
Don't walk against me; the venom spreads.
Come back to the rust pit; it's quiet there.
Your tusks are short; I don't mind.
Back to back, we guard this fog.
Venom against venom; neither of us falls.
Slow down; these legs can match your pace.
Two iron hides pressed together will creak.
This ground is too soft; let's find harder.
Let me scrape the rust off you.

lines.zh: 你叫一声，我就知道方位。
lines.en: Call once and I'll know where you are.
When the fog clears, we'll find water together.

lines.zh: 地上这块骨头，我咬得动。
lines.en: That bone on the ground; my teeth can take it.
I lift it with a tusk; saves effort.
There's iron in this pile of rust.
I don't pick up small things; they lodge in my teeth.
If it crushes, I leave it.
This stone is heavy enough to step on.

lines.zh: 我低头叼起，脖子响了一下。
lines.en: I dip my head and lift it; my neck pops.

lines.zh: 地上的尸骨，我拖回坑里。
lines.en: I drag the remains back to my pit.
The venom softened it; convenient.
I can't be bothered to use a hand.
A shape shifts somewhere inside the fog.
That scent is fresh and living.
It's smaller than me; no hurry.

lines.zh: 脚下震了一下，源头在那边。
lines.en: The ground shook once; the source is that way.
I see a pair of legs running.

lines.zh: 目标不远，我的牙开始痒。
lines.en: The target is close; my teeth begin to itch.

lines.zh: 它躲到石头后，石头不够厚。
lines.en: It hid behind a rock that isn't thick enough.

lines.zh: 我低头，先对准它的胸口。
lines.en: I lower my head and aim at its chest.
I've got this scent; it won't escape.
Now that you're here, you don't leave empty.

lines.zh: 雾那边有脚步，一深一浅。
lines.en: Footsteps beyond the fog, one deep one shallow.

lines.zh: 它的甲在反光，我看得清。
lines.en: Its armor reflects light; I see it clearly.

lines.zh: 这东西会喊，得先让它闭嘴。
lines.en: This thing can shout; silence it first.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，把象牙朝向那边。
lines.en: I raise my head and point my tusks that way.
That torchlight in the fog. I dislike it.
Its footsteps are too even.

lines.zh: 我先走直线，它一定会躲。
lines.en: I walk straight; it will surely dodge.

lines.zh: 毒在我嘴里积着，快满了。
lines.en: Venom pools in my mouth; nearly full.

lines.zh: 等它靠近墙，就无处可退。
lines.en: Let it near the wall and there's no retreat.
I stay quiet; a roar would warn it.

lines.zh: 十二点五的力，一下就够。
lines.en: Twelve and a half points; one hit is enough.
It goes left; I block left first.
Iron hide ignores arrows; only fire worries it.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，让象牙对齐。
lines.en: I lower my bulk so the tusks line up.
I wait for it to gasp, then I move.
It will remember this charge for a long time.

lines.zh: 它靠近水洼，脚会陷进去。
lines.en: Near the puddle its feet will sink.

lines.zh: 我先撞断它退路的那棵树。
lines.en: First I break the tree blocking its retreat.

lines.zh: 等它举盾，我就顶它的腿。
lines.en: When it raises the shield, I go for its legs.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪，铁皮的声音太响。
lines.en: I move slowly; my iron hide is too loud.

lines.zh: 我数它喘气的间隔，快了。
lines.en: I count its breaths. They quicken.

lines.zh: 它贴着墙走，墙挡不住毒。
lines.en: It hugs the wall. Walls don't stop poison.

lines.zh: 我往后退半步，是为了撞。
lines.en: I step back half a pace to charge.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛在我肩上找破绽。
lines.en: Its eyes hunt a gap at my shoulder.
When it lifts a foot, I thrust.

lines.zh: 它开始绕圈，圈会越收越小。
lines.en: It circles. The circle keeps shrinking.
One tusk flick and the body flies.
My teeth carry venom; the wound will rot.

lines.zh: 撞上的一刻，我听见闷响。
lines.en: At this impact, bones rattle.

lines.zh: 铁皮擦过你的甲，出火星。
lines.en: My hide scrapes your plate and sparks fly.
I drop my weight and crater the ground.
You fell back two steps; I take three.
I hold the bite until the venom works.

lines.zh: 我的力道，你挡不住第二下。
lines.en: You won't block a second blow of mine.

lines.zh: 打中了，你的甲凹了一块。
lines.en: Hit; a dent appears in your plate.

lines.zh: 躺下也没用，我闻得到血。
lines.en: Don't play dead; I can smell the difference.

lines.zh: 顶到胸口，它整个人后仰。
lines.en: A hit to the chest and it bends backward.
My hoof comes down and the ground sinks.

lines.zh: 甩头，象牙划开一道口子。
lines.en: I swing my head and a tusk opens a gash.

lines.zh: 它砍在我背上，只留白印。
lines.en: It cut my back and left only a white mark.

lines.zh: 象牙挑起来，它撞上了石头。
lines.en: My tusks lift it into the rock wall.

lines.zh: 我压住它的胸口，听见骨响。
lines.en: I crush its chest and hear the bones.

lines.zh: 这一下有毒，伤口会发黑。
lines.en: This one is poisoned. The wound will blacken.

lines.zh: 它砍在我肩甲上，滑开了。
lines.en: Its blade slid off my iron shoulder.
I shake my head and blood flies into the fog.
It falls. I keep pushing forward.
I pull myself out of the rust mud.
My first breath is all acid.
The fog is thick; I only know my own scent.

lines.zh: 铁壳还没硬，走起来发软。
lines.en: My iron hide is still soft; walking feels loose.
The puddles around are black; good.
I shake my back and rust dust rises.

lines.zh: 地上的骨头，是谁留下的。
lines.en: Whose bones are these on the ground?
I try a roar; it comes out gravelly.

lines.zh: 象牙顶到石头，我知道它硬。
lines.en: My tusk meets stone; now I know it's hard.

lines.zh: 从今天起，这片雾归我走。
lines.en: From today this fog is mine to walk.

lines.zh: 我闻到远处有活物在走。
lines.en: I smell something alive walking far off.

lines.zh: 这身铁壳重得我起身很慢。
lines.en: This iron shell is so heavy I rise slowly.
Fire bakes my rust and the stench is sharp.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，砸出深坑。
lines.en: I fall from above and hammer out a deep pit.
Soaked through, my iron shell starts to bubble.
The blast shoves me back, but the iron holds.
The arrow sticks in my rust and leaves a pale dot.

lines.zh: 那股药水味，把毒逼回去。
lines.en: That potion smell drives my venom back inside.

lines.zh: 饿的时候，我的牙自己磨。
lines.en: When I'm starving, my teeth grind on their own.
Lightning runs the length of my iron hide.

lines.zh: 虚空连我的重量都不认。
lines.en: Even the void won't acknowledge my weight.
